page.overview:
Who is Ginji?

As a banker, he managed Kakuzu's extensive wealth that was obtained through collecting the bounties on ninja.

Ginji has a crop of short, dull, black hair and dark eyes. He wears a simple blue suit along with a pair of shoes. He's also seen with a cigar in his mouth.

After Kakuzu's death, Hebi sought him out to learn about Akatsuki's whereabouts. After hearing a disturbance outside, he sends Kyōya to investigate. However, both men are hostilely subdued by Suigetsu Hōzuki using the Kubikiribōchō. After Kyōya is knocked out, Ginji quickly tells Suigetsu that he'll tell him anything he wanted to know and begged Suigetsu to spare him.
